ShirtVote.title: ShirtVote
ShirtVote.description: Represents a single 'I'd wear this' vote for a specific shirt design and colorway by an anonymous visitor.

shirtId.description: The identifier of the shirt design/colorway being voted on.

visitorId.description: The anonymous visitor identifier scoped to one vote per shirt.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vote was recorded.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Stores a visitor's CYZBORG chatbot conversation transcript and apparel/fabric recommendations for the site owner.

visitorId.description: The anonymous visitor identifier owning this chat session.

summary.description: Latest visitor prompt or summary of apparel/fabric recommendations.

transcript.description: Full formatted conversation transcript between the visitor and CYZBORG.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in the recorded conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat session started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat session was last updated.

/shirtVotes/{voteId}.description: Stores one active vote per shirtId and visitorId combination. Individual visitors can create, get, and delete their own deterministic voteId document; only the verified site owner can list all votes to view private totals.

/chatSessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores recorded visitor chatbot conversations and apparel recommendations keyed by deterministic sessionId ('chat_' + visitorId). Only the verified site owner can list all recorded chat sessions.
